thread:
sam: Heads up: eu-west rack19 host-91/92 showing intermittent PCIe fabric errors + GPU DMA timeouts since 15:04 UTC. Users reporting tail token latency spikes. Suspect one tenant blasting multi-stream decodes.

ivy: Any counters? quick grep: `dmesg | grep -i dma` -> repeated timeout entries + `ethtool -S` shows rx_errors rising on host-91.

sam: snippet: ```
host-91: nvlink_crc=56 pci_rx_errors=132 kernel: GPU DMA timeout
host-92: nvlink_crc=3 pci_rx_errors=18
```

natalie: Tenant 10017 scaled concurrency last deploy, window=10k. We should shepherd them before whole rack degrades. Options: soft-ratecap + cache-ttl reduction OR create topology-pinned hot-slice.

ops-bot: Alert: PCI_FABRIC_DEGRADATION rack=rack19 severity=high

ivy: My vote = shepherd (soft-ratecap) as canary on host-91 only. Less churn. Command: `POST $ALLOC/v1/tenants/10017/actions {"type":"ratecap","concurrency":2,"kvcache_ms":2000}` Run on host-91, monitor 5m.

sam: If that stabilizes, sweep rack. If not, fallback: `./infra/provision_hot_slice --tenant=10017 --zone=eu-west-1 --placement=nvlink-friendly` (cost ~+0.7x/hr). Notify billing if we move to hot-slice.

natalie: Also add a quick dashboard mapping nvlink_crc -> recommended action so oncall sees guidance. I'll open a tiny PR.

ivy: Canary started at 15:09:12 UTC on host-91. After 4m: pci_rx_errors 132->14, nvlink_crc cleared, tail latency back to baseline. :white_check_mark:

sam: Nice. Sweep applied to host-92 as well. Capture runbook commands and rollback: `POST $ALLOC/v1/tenants/10017/actions {"type":"clear_limits"}`.

ops-bot: Action log: tenant=10017 action=ratecap scope=rack19 outcome=success
